items.title: Throwing cow dung: Diwali celebrations take an unusual turn in southern India
items.summary: The third day of Diwali was marked in a memorable way on Wednesday in Gummatapura, a hamlet located in India's Tamil Nadu state. Local men and boys threw cow dung at each other to celebrate the festival of Gorehabba which honours Lord Beereshwara, a God worshipped by locals. Believed to be around 300 years old, the festival attracts tourists from across India and further afield.

items.title: Rare pictures from Marilyn Monroe's final shoot on auction in Paris
items.summary: Prints from the personal collection of photographer Bert Stern are going under the hammer in Paris on December 2, marking the first time his private archive has been offered for sale. Among the highlights of the auction are iconic photographs of Marilyn Monroe, taken just weeks before her death.
